name: Random Google Photos Slideshow
description: Create a randomized full-screen photo and video slideshow from a public Google Photos shared album.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com; media-src 'self' blob: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com; connect-src 'self' https://photos.google.com https://photos.app.goo.gl https://lh3.googleusercontent.com;
